annotations.title: List the models saved on your account

description: Lists the graphs saved on your Neumann account, the most recently updated first. Use this when the user refers to a model they saved earlier and you do not know its graph_id; it is how you find the id that get_graph, rank_inputs_by_impact, summarize_outcome_scenarios and delete_graph need. It does not list runs or results -- it lists the models themselves. It returns one entry per graph with its graph_id, name, when it was last updated and how many input and formula nodes it has, plus next_offset when there are more to page through. It needs a Neumann account: send your key, or your signed-in token, in the Authorization header as a Bearer credential. No Neumann tool takes an api_key argument. Cost: free -- it debits no credits and spends none of your free daily runs -- but it needs an account; an anonymous caller gets authentication_required.
